P1.severity_rationale: P1 (misleading provenance, not a wrong-result P0): the production model registry declared stroke.heuristic-hierarchical@stroke-heuristic-1 while the only live implementation is STROKE_HEURISTIC_VERSION='stroke-heuristic-6 (uncalibrated)'. Every mobile AUTO DETECT analysis Result therefore recorded modelVersion 'stroke-heuristic-1' in its ModelRun provenance despite running v6 semantics (5 behavior revisions unrecorded, including D11/F20 safety gates). Predictions themselves carry the correct classifierVersion, so records were internally contradictory rather than silently wrong-stroke.
P1.fix: defaultManifest.ts entry bumped to stroke-heuristic-6; registry lock test updated; NEW cross-package regression test packages/vision-geometry/test/modelRegistryProvenance.test.ts asserts the registry's production stroke_classification version equals the live STROKE_HEURISTIC_VERSION identifier on every supported platform, so any future classifier version bump fails CI until the manifest is updated in the same change.

P2.detail: Stale 'stroke-heuristic-1' references in live source comments (packages/analysis-pipeline/src/strokeAutoResolution.ts, packages/shared-types/src/techniqueIntent.ts) rewritten version-agnostically to reference STROKE_HEURISTIC_VERSION; confidence formulas quoted in those comments were re-verified against the v6 implementation (0.45+0.5·margin sides, 0.5+lift/2 overhead) and remain accurate. Historical dataset artifacts and test fixture payload strings intentionally left untouched.

Not an unversioned-behavior risk: the worker speaks the versioned paddle-serve-v1 protocol, is disable-able via --no-paddle-worker, and Result provenance is unaffected. rationale: One authoritative production route exists per task: the ModelRegistry (defaultManifest) is the only mapping from tasks to implementations, resolve() defaults to production status, and AUTO DETECT structurally refuses to run without a registered classifier. The g26 dedup outcome is consumed and holds at this baseline: zero duplicate classifier implementations remain (re-export + 19/19 parity guard). Zero experimental features are default-on (adaptive completion is explicit-opt-in, non-persistent; --merge-tracklets/--two-pass are opt-in lab flags; registry never implicitly serves experimental/shadow entries). Every default-on behavior has a disable/rollback path. Model/config changes are versioned and provenance is recorded per-run in Result.modelRuns and top-level Result version fields. The single real defect found (registry/classifier version drift, P1 F1) was fixed with a regression test that makes recurrence a CI failure. Verdict PASS is Linux-static-audit scoped: no device measurements claimed.
